name: Clash Triage
description: Read-only clash triage: match each Navisworks clash item to a Revit element by UniqueId or IFC GUID, report how sure each match is (exact, ambiguous, unmatched), and record the result as an issue. Never changes the model.
author: AEC Model Bridge

clash_results.description: The clash results as returned by navisworks_get_clash_results (an object with a 'results' list), or just that list.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot of the Revit model to match against. Required when connected to Revit.

record_issues.description: Record each clash as an issue in the workspace so it can be listed later.

doc_guid.description: Only issues for this Revit document.

match.description: Only clashes with this overall match confidence.
